Let’s break this down step by step.  

The SVG path has these points in order:  

1. M 41.10,39.10 → starting point  
2. L 37.66,20.53  
3. L 49.73,18.29  
4. L 59.87,21.21  
5. M 59.87,21.21 (move to same point — maybe redundant)  
6. L 65.24,34.62  
7. L 49.95,55.71  
8. L 29.03,41.34  
9. L 41.10,39.10 (back to start)  

So the sequence of distinct vertices is:  

(41.10,39.10)  
(37.66,20.53)  
(49.73,18.29)  
(59.87,21.21)  
(65.24,34.62)  
(49.95,55.71)  
(29.03,41.34)  
(41.10,39.10)  

That’s 8 distinct points (the first and last are the same to close the shape).  

An 8-sided polygon is an **octagon**.  

Final answer: (F)
